Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that had been healthy in production was v2.3.0.
2. **Rolled back all regions** to v2.3.0. Verified afterward: all three regions now run v2.3.0, service is healthy, and the error rate dropped to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification details. Notable for investigation: v2.3.1-rc also failed health checks in staging, suggesting the defect predates the production rollout.
